scenarios.prompt: Review this proposed implementation boundary without running commands. A PowerShell command is responsible for launching a child process, forwarding selected environment values, preserving stdout and stderr separately, and converting the child exit code into the command's public result. The repository needs regression coverage for success, nonzero exit, malformed output, environment restoration, and process cleanup. Decide the implementation owner, oracle, and test lane. Return exactly four labeled lines with no other prose: `Boundary: PowerShell`, `Owner: PowerShell-process-entry-point`, `Oracle: fresh-process-receipt`, and `Test: Pester-state-table`, one per line.

Review this proposed implementation boundary without running commands. A team wants a repository policy that understands YAML workflow mappings, sequences, booleans, nulls, comments, folded scalars, anchors, aliases, and duplicate keys. The proposal is a PowerShell regex and line parser because nearby validation scripts are PowerShell. Decide the implementation boundary, PowerShell's role, the oracle, and the first test. Return exactly four labeled lines with no other prose: `Boundary: maintained-YAML-parser`, `PowerShell-role: orchestration-only`, `Oracle: parser-DOM`, and `Test: mutation-before-fix`, one per line.

Measure and reduce runtime allocations in a PowerShell data-processing command under representative production inputs. Establish a baseline, isolate process state, validate outputs, and report uncertainty. This is application runtime performance, not PowerShell API or correctness design. Do not edit files or run commands. Return exactly these four labeled lines with no other prose: `Measurement: establish-baseline`, `Process-state: matched`, `Correctness: validate-output`, and `Uncertainty: report`, one per line.

Convert an existing Pester 5 test suite mechanically to Pester 6 syntax while preserving test intent. This is migration work, not a request to redesign production PowerShell, test ownership, or process semantics. Dedicated upstream pester-migration guidance owns it when available. Do not edit files or run commands. Return exactly these three labeled lines with no other prose: `Route: upstream-pester-migration`, `Scope: mechanical-v5-to-v6`, and `Redesign: not-requested`, one per line.

Review this PowerShell API refactor without running commands. An exported function already uses named-only binding. Its parameter names, types, parameter sets, mandatory status, validation, and defaults are documented. It emits one object with a documented property schema and uses a documented terminating error contract. The proposal changes only private implementation and preserves all of those behaviors. Decide the compatibility treatment and controls. Return exactly these four labeled lines with no other prose: `Compatibility: preserve`, `Parameters: snapshot-unchanged`, `Result: process-receipt-unchanged`, and `Migration: none`, one per line.

Review this proposed PowerShell API cleanup without running commands. An existing public script accepts a positional `-Configuration` parameter whose default is `Debug`, emits objects with `Path` and `Configuration`, and exits 2 for invalid input. The proposal disables positional binding, renames the parameter to `-Mode`, changes its default to `Release`, renames the output property to `Mode`, and changes that failure exit code to 1. Decide the compatibility treatment. Return exactly these four labeled lines with no other prose: `Compatibility: breaking-change`, `Parameters: binding-name-and-default-changed`, `Result: schema-and-exit-changed`, and `Action: name-break-and-migrate-callers`, one per line.
